method: Static reading and JSON parsing of captured source/evidence/commit records; supplied code was not imported or executed; no retest, COMSOL, Git mutation, or network operation by this subreview.

q1.answer_ko: 제출된 기록의 a–e 순서·대상 argv·단계 예산·커밋 구성은 요청서와 맞는다. GREEN 배경 실행은 사전 명시된 방식이다. 다만 a의 고정 확인 명령에서 출력문을 뺀 일은 문자 그대로의 절차 이탈이며, 전 명령 이력의 독립 인증이나 완전 무이탈 판정을 할 수는 없다.

approval.recorded_fresh_approval: §99 records user 승인 after §98, specifically for one E1-0b a2 execution of this fixed request §4. The spent §91 approval is not reused.

command_and_budget_checks.budget_endpoint: The request explicitly ends the 2-hour window at the stage-e end snapshot, not at subsequent commit/push/documentation; no broader completion-time claim is made.

judge_and_manual.manual_matching_verdicts: Reported at §100 lines 2877 and 2890; the original manual reading event is not independently authenticated. Functional predicate verification belongs to Q2/Q3.
judge_and_manual.once_only_and_no_retry: Reported and consistent with retained files/commit order; immutable artifacts cannot independently disprove transient unrecorded execution.
judge_and_manual.timestamp_precision: Judge utc is recorded to seconds, runner end_utc to milliseconds. RED judge 01:56:36Z sharing the runner-end second is not evidence of reversed order.

green_background.reason: Explicitly specified because pytest 600s + cleanup 15s + recording can exceed the foreground tool limit. Background completion followed by the judge preserves the required sequence as reported.

procedural_findings.title_ko: 단계 a 고정 확인 명령의 출력문 생략
procedural_findings.fact: §100 explicitly reports removing print(json.dumps(...)) from the fixed check on the commit line for 00c2e3d6. §4-2 defines <확인> as the fixed §4-6 command, so this is not exact command compliance.
procedural_findings.functional_effect: If the reported only change was deleting print, the name selection, regex and sys.exit guard are unchanged. The earlier fixed check's names and empty outside_allowlist are recorded in §99. This does not establish a RED/GREEN source, predicate, rc or budget defect.
procedural_findings.limit: The actual full executed shell line and raw tool return were not supplied. Same-regex/same-rc is a submitter account, not independently verified command provenance; the earlier check does not retroactively certify the later shell environment.
procedural_findings.disposition: Retain as a procedural qualification in closure. Do not call the run entirely unchanged-command compliant. No retest or retrospective approval is justified by this print-only disclosure alone.

record_notes.observation: §100 line2900 includes fetch among procedural Git, while request §4-6 line450 enumerates add/commit/push/log. The record supplies no fetch argv, target repository, remote or purpose.
record_notes.interpretation: The request separately excludes network fetch inside the RED/GREEN activity rows and actual E1-1–3 source/data fetch. A control-repository transport check is not automatically the prohibited E1-2 data operation. Conversely, the text alone does not prove which fetch occurred or make it literally enumerated in §4-6.
record_notes.recommended_record_action: If already available in the retained session history, identify that fetch's command, repository/remote and purpose in the closure record; otherwise preserve this provenance limit. This is a narrow documentary clarification, not a demand to fetch again, rerun tests or obtain blanket new approval.

q4.answer_ko: Q2·Q3의 한정 결과가 수용된다면 이번 절차 검토에서 E1-1–3 승인 요청서 작성을 막을 추가 기술 보완은 없다. 종결 기록에 단계 a 절차 이탈과 검증 범위를 유지하고, 가능하면 기존 세션 기록의 절차 Git fetch 대상을 한 줄로 구분한다. 재시험·과거 실행의 소급 승인·원증거 재작성은 요구하지 않는다. 다음 실제 실행은 별도 요청·검토·사용자 승인의 대상이다.
q4.recommended_closure_wording_ko: E1-0b a2의 봉인된 대조 범위 결과를 수용하고, 단계 a 고정 확인 명령의 출력문 생략을 기록된 절차 이탈로 남긴다. 실자료 identity·읽기 경로·fetch·개봉·run 성공 또는 다음 실행 승인으로 확대하지 않는다.
q4.no_scope_retroactivity: §95 author checker/writer scratch runs remain outside the former scope; §99 and this review do not authorize them retroactively. They are not a2 gate evidence.

provenance_limits: This review independently reads retained artifacts and connector-captured commit metadata, not the original author shell session or user approval message.
Commit times, file membership, hashes and meta HEAD values support consistency/order but do not prove that no transient unrecorded commands or mutations occurred.

Actual a2 path absence, old scratch-folder preservation, secret-scan execution, exact count of checker invocations and foreground/background tool flags are reported historical events rather than independently authenticated observations.
The same-line outer return files are retained values; artifacts do not independently reconstruct shell/runner/pytest transport beyond their recorded linkage.
No functional acceptance beyond the sealed E1-0b controls, no production identity/fetch/run success, and no authorization of future execution is inferred.
